english.title: Fail to comply with a requirement in a notice that a door / gate / bar in a public building shall not open outwards
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having been served with a notice under section 153(2) of the Highways Act 1980 requiring you to alter, so as not to open outwards a

(A)_[door]_
(B)_[gate]_
(C)_[bar]_

put up, in contravention of section 153(1) of that Act, on premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) occupied by you, failed to comply with that notice within 8 days of its service on you
english.legislation: Contrary to section 153(5) of the Highways Act 1980.

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
